snippet.title: Dream Office DLC Decor Pack Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🏢 The Dream Office: Decor Pack DLC is coming October 1st!

Your office is functional. Now it's time to give it some personality.

Decor Pack adds a whole new selection of furniture, decorations and materials, including chairs, desks, shelves, bookcases, cabinets, tables, lamps, plants, clocks, office items, and new wall and floor materials.

Redesign your workspace and make your office truly yours.

📅 The Dream Office: Decor Pack – October 1st

Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5204820/The_Dream_Office__Office_Decor_Pack
